name: file_matching_with_tsx_and_dts_of_same_n_3ade5022
subject: Fix file matching with tsx and dts of same name are included by include patterns (#55690)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: File matching for include patterns wrongly treated .d.ts files as matching .ts, so same-named .d.ts/.ts/.tsx files were handled incorrectly. The fix changes hasFileWithHigherPriorityExtension in commandLineParser.
